learning: Canonical learning persistence and BG167 shared-context projection are distinct completion states. A BG166 result of COALESCED_REFRESH with learning_persisted=true is a successful canonical write, not a failed writeback; the projection refresh may be deliberately deferred by the cost-recovery window.
prevention: Never replay a material learning merely because BG167 projection refresh was coalesced after BG166 confirmed learning_persisted=true.
Only replay the same learning after an actual canonical write failure or negative downstream readback, using the stable fingerprint for dedupe.
Treat Make scenario status plus successful execution evidence as recovery proof; do not infer recovery from isActive alone.
